entities.name: Bálint Pásztor
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bálint Pásztor is a Serbian politician. An ethnic Hungarian, he has led the Alliance of Vojvodina Hungarians (VMSZ) since October 2023, initially on an acting basis and since March 2024 as the party's elected president. Pásztor has served in the Serbian parliament since 2007 and was also the president of the Subotica city assembly from 2020 to 2024.
